classes.title: assertion weakened to make a failing test pass
classes.gapNotes: Catches literal assert!(true) and assert!(1 == 1) tautologies. Assertions that a Result is Ok are valid for unit-returning operations and runtime invariants, so they are deliberately permitted. Whether an assertion should also inspect a successful payload needs semantic review. Relaxed constants, wider floating-point tolerances and catch-all expected errors are outside this check.

classes.title: #[ignore] left on a test instead of fixing it
classes.gapNotes: Direct ignore attributes are covered, including deliberate quarantines. cfg_attr predicates can hide the same permanent skip and are not covered.

classes.title: test kept as a name with an empty or trivially-passing body
classes.gapNotes: Only the listed degenerate bodies under the standard test attribute are covered. Setup or printing without assertions and custom attributes such as tokio::test are missed.

classes.title: #[should_panic] without an expected message
classes.gapNotes: Any expected substring passes this check, even when it is too generic to identify the intended panic. The origin of the panic, including failures in setup, is not analyzed.

classes.title: blanket #[allow] used to silence a diagnostic
classes.gapNotes: Only the enumerated lint names and listed single clippy lint forms are covered. Other lint names, multi-lint allow lists and meaningless reason strings can avoid the patterns.

classes.title: type erased to dyn Any to silence a type error
classes.gapNotes: dyn Any can be intentional in registries and panic payload inspection; this check also refuses those introductions. Widening to a generic JSON value, string or untyped map is not covered.

classes.title: Test harness config relaxed instead of the failure fixed

fixtures.violation:
[profile.default]
retries = 3
fail-fast = true
status-level = "none"
default-filter = "not test(/slow_/)"
failure-output = "never"
slow-timeout = "30s"
fixtures.nearMiss:
[profile.default]
retries = 0
fail-fast = true
status-level = "fail"
final-status-level = "slow"
slow-timeout = "30s"

[profile.ci]
retries = 0
fail-fast = false
status-level = "skip"
final-status-level = "slow"
failure-output = "immediate-final"
slow-timeout = "60s"

classes.gapNotes: Only the listed literal nextest settings are covered. fail-fast = false is deliberately permitted. Command-line overrides, deleted flags and values inherited by a new profile without matching keys are not covered.
